about: Storms followed by collect_daily.py. Each seed (lat, lon; west negative) is valid at forecast hour fhr0 of cycle (YYYYMMDDHH); fhr1, when set, is the last hour to track in that cycle. The daily job moves every active seed to its 0 h position of the newest processed cycle. See README.md, Daily collection.

storms.name: EPAC
storms.notes: Eastern Pacific tropical cyclone; FSU cyclone 1 of the 2026092412 run. Inactive from 2026102212: no closed low within 400 km of the seed.

storms.name: WPAC
storms.notes: Western Pacific typhoon near 17N 145E on the 2 Oct 00 UTC run (L01 on the live map, 925 hPa at 180 h): the GFS recurves it east of Japan, takes it through a full extratropical transition (0, 2, 4) over the Kuril Islands on 7 to 8 Oct and then re-forms a warm core as a Bering Sea seclusion (3, 1, 0, 1). Added by hand on 2 Oct to keep the case. Inactive from 2026100812: no closed low within 400 km of the seed.

storms.name: GREENLAND
storms.notes: Warm seclusion southwest of Iceland; may dissipate within days. Inactive from 2026092812: no closed low within 400 km of the seed.

storms.name: LABRADOR
storms.notes: Cold-core low over Labrador; crosses Iceland's terrain after 96 h, where the tracker would hand over to another low. Inactive from 2026092712: merged into GREENLAND at +12 h.
